data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Nov 16, 2023

## [I bought a vase.. Mistake!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65568f6c0e76dcfa8237849f)
I bought a vase, nearly 400.00; it arrived in several pieces. I’d love to blame the horrendous Fed Ex, but honestly, this was THE silliest, nothing of a packing job I have ever seen…not to mention they require you to install SHOP app to find out if your rattling packsge is even in the pipeline— it wasn’t. I immediately dumped SHOP. Lulu and Georgia? Don’t do it,

November 16, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 18, 2023

Hi Ralph, we are so incredibly sorry to hear about the condition of the vase. Thank you for the feedback, we have shared this with the appropriate teams. Apologies for the inconvenience that this has caused you. We can see that our Customer Experience team processed a full refund for the vase, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
